entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling about an order. I just... I feel really let down. I bought some shoes a while ago and they're just not working out.
I'm very sorry to hear you're feeling that way. I can definitely look into this for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is David Miller, and the order number is... VF77812. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I've never had a problem like this before.

Thank you, David. I see your account now, and we really appreciate your loyalty. I see you purchased the Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I thought they would be perfect, but the cycling shoes just give me terrible blisters every time I use them. I've tried adjusting the cleats, wearing different socks, everything. They're just painful.
Oh no, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for you. That sounds very uncomfortable. I'm looking at your purchase date, and I can see you ordered them 77 days ago.

I know, I kept trying to make them work because I really didn't want to be a bother. But it's just not happening. I was really hoping I could get a refund for them. Honestly, with the holidays coming up, I really needed this money back.

Of course, I completely understand. Let me just confirm our policy. Okay, yes. For our standard items like these shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're at day 77, you are well within that period. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I was just stuck with them.

Not at all. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file. And since you're a VIP member and had such a poor experience, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for the inconvenience. You can use that on any future purchase.
Wow, a credit too? You really didn't have to do that. Thank you, that's incredibly kind. You've really turned my day around.
It's my pleasure, David. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for all your help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
